notes: Forward-compatible application schema 109 to 112. Migrations through 110 are immutable applied production history. This release migrates from schema 110 to 112. Migration 111 adds multi-category product associations while preserving the primary category_id compatibility field. Migration 112 allows products and their owned variants to be deleted atomically while order, inventory, and loyalty history continues to restrict deletion. A verified schema-110 backup is required before migration; recovery is forward-repair-only after schema advances beyond 110.
